retained_requirement_surfaces.text: QA recognizes the full layer taxonomy: unit, interface, contract, integration, smoke, functional, regression, exception, compatibility, and browser E2E.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-001::qa recognizes the full layer taxonomy: unit, interface, contract, integration, smoke, functional, regression, exception, compatibility, and browser e2e.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: QA profiles distinguish `basic`, `complete`, `closure`, and `browser`, and report whether a run is partial or complete.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-002::qa profiles distinguish `basic`, `complete`, `closure`, and `browser`, and report whether a run is partial or complete.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Human-selected layers and commands are allowed, but partial runs are explicitly marked and cannot satisfy closure unless the selected scope matches the required profile.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-003::human-selected layers and commands are allowed, but partial runs are explicitly marked and cannot satisfy closure unless the selected scope matches the required profile.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Non-browser features run or justify unit, interface, contract, integration, smoke, regression, exception, and compatibility coverage before closure.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-004::non-browser features run or justify unit, interface, contract, integration, smoke, regression, exception, and compatibility coverage before closure.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Browser features require real browser E2E evidence for function, UI, UX, compatibility, session, and state/data consistency.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-005::browser features require real browser e2e evidence for function, ui, ux, compatibility, session, and state/data consistency.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Project-native E2E scripts can be discovered or selected and bound to AC/test IDs.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-006::project-native e2e scripts can be discovered or selected and bound to ac/test ids.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Browser runner registry includes Playwright, Playwright CLI, Playwright CDP, browser-use, agent-browser, attached browser, web-access, and Obscura CDP.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-007::browser runner registry includes playwright, playwright cli, playwright cdp, browser-use, agent-browser, attached browser, web-access, and obscura cdp.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Listing commands, placeholder transcripts, and documentation-only pass notes cannot satisfy acceptance.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-008::listing commands, placeholder transcripts, and documentation-only pass notes cannot satisfy acceptance.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: QA acceptance transactions include run ID, source commands, runner/browser identity, accepted test IDs, evidence refs, and failure attribution.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-009::qa acceptance transactions include run id, source commands, runner/browser identity, accepted test ids, evidence refs, and failure attribution.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Browser-required scenarios without valid browser evidence block QA/release.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-010::browser-required scenarios without valid browser evidence block qa/release.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Failure attribution routes gaps to implement, test-case, change/refreeze, QA rerun, or blocked admission based on evidence.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-011::failure attribution routes gaps to implement, test-case, change/refreeze, qa rerun, or blocked admission based on evidence.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Release consumes formal QA closure only; raw runner output or support evidence cannot directly become release pass evidence.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::ac-012::release consumes formal qa closure only; raw runner output or support evidence cannot directly become release pass evidence.::
